operation.refresh.success: Standard time is up to date.
operation.sync.success: The system time was synchronized and verified.
operation.servers.success: The server list was saved. Standard time is being refreshed with the new list.
operation.schedule.success: The automatic time sync schedule was updated.
operation.removeSchedule.success: The automatic time sync schedule was removed.
operation.failure.remoteTime: A new standard time could not be fetched, so the system time was not changed. Check the network and try again.
operation.failure.server: None of the configured time servers responded, so the system time was not changed. Review the server list and try again.
operation.failure.authorizationDenied: System authorization was cancelled, so the system time was not changed. Try again and allow authorization when you are ready.
operation.failure.privilege: This account cannot change the system time. Review the account permissions or system policy and try again.
operation.failure.systemRejected: Windows refused to change the system time. Review the system policy and try again.
operation.failure.verification: A system time change was attempted, but the result could not be verified. Run the sync again.
operation.failure.uncertain: The operation may have changed system state, but its final result is uncertain. Check the current time and try again when safe.
operation.failure.cancelled: The operation was cancelled before any change was completed.
operation.failure.invalidConfiguration: The configuration is invalid. The existing settings were kept. Correct the values and try again.
operation.failure.save: The server list could not be saved. The existing list was kept. Check write access to the application folder and try again.
operation.failure.scheduleAuthorization: Schedule authorization was cancelled. The existing schedule was kept. Try again and allow authorization when you are ready.
operation.failure.scheduleUpdate: The automatic time sync schedule could not be updated. The existing schedule was kept. Check permissions or system policy and try again.
operation.failure.scheduleRemove: The automatic time sync schedule could not be removed. Check permissions or system policy and try again.
operation.failure.unknown: The operation did not complete. Try again.
operation.refresh.failure: Standard time could not be refreshed. Check the network and try again.
operation.sync.failure: System time sync failed, and no change was confirmed. Try again.
operation.servers.failure: The server list could not be saved. The existing list was kept. Try again.
operation.schedule.failure: The automatic time sync schedule could not be updated. The existing schedule was kept. Try again.
operation.removeSchedule.failure: The automatic time sync schedule could not be removed. Try again.
